title: Agent stdout is data, not Python source
description: Audit finding AF-4 (#4219): expect/scripts/report.sh spliced RUN_RESULT and RUN_SUMMARY, parsed from browser-agent stdout that a hostile page can steer, into a python3 -c program, so a crafted RUN_COMPLETED line executed as Python. The fix sends every run field through environment variables into a quoted-heredoc program. Feed a breakout payload and compare what the old splice did with it against what the env channel does, then see the same data-not-source treatment applied to the five sibling script injections.
